% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway train rescheduling with rerouting, retiming and passenger delay
%@ desc :: Integer linear programming model on a space–time network that selects routes, start times and passenger assignment to minimise total passenger delay and the number of unserved passengers.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index A ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of arcs in the space–time network.
%@ index N ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of nodes (station–time points).
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of passenger groups (origin‑destination pairs).
%@ param cap shape=A kind=scalar domain=integer :: Capacity of arc a (max number of trains simultaneously).
%@ param trav shape=A kind=scalar domain=time :: Travel time of arc a.
%@ param tail shape=A kind=scalar domain=node :: Tail node of arc a.
%@ param head shape=A kind=scalar domain=node :: Head node of arc a.
%@ param source shape=T kind=scalar domain=node :: Source node of train t.
%@ param sink shape=T kind=scalar domain=node :: Sink node of train t.
%@ param orig shape=P kind=scalar domain=node :: Origin node of passenger group p.
%@ param dest shape=P kind=scalar domain=node :: Destination node of passenger group p.
%@ param demand shape=P kind=scalar domain=passenger :: Number of passengers in group p.
%@ param origtime shape=P kind=scalar domain=time :: Original scheduled travel time for group p (without disruption).
%@ param weight_delay shape=P kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight for delay of passenger group p (typically w_delay·demand_p).
%@ param w_unserved shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Penalty per unserved passenger.
%@ param M_big shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Big‑M constant for delay linking.
%@ var x shape=T,A domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Train t uses arc a (routing and timing).
%@ var y shape=T,N domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Train t visits node n.
%@ var z shape=P,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger group p assigned to train t.
%@ var delay shape=P domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Total delay incurred by passenger group p.
%@ var unserved shape=P domain=integer role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Number of unserved passengers of group p.
%@ var travt shape=T domain=continuous role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Travel time of train t.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimise weighted passenger delay plus penalty for unserved passengers.
%@ con source_out kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train leaves its source node on exactly one outgoing arc.
%@ con sink_in kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train enters its sink node on exactly one incoming arc.
%@ con flow_cons kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Flow conservation at intermediate nodes.
%@ con node_visit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Link node visitation variables to arc selections.
%@ con arc_cap kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arc capacity limits.
%@ con pass_assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each passenger group is either assigned to a train or left unserved.
%@ con origin_vis kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assigned passengers must have their origin visited.
%@ con dest_vis kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assigned passengers must have their destination visited.
%@ con trav_time_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Define travel time of each train.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Relate passenger delay to train travel time.
%@ con unserved_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Unserved passengers cannot exceed demand.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{weight\_delay}_p \cdot \mathit{delay}_{p}
            + \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{w\_unserved} \cdot \mathit{unserved}_{p}
            \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A} : \mathit{tail}_a = \mathit{source}_t} x_{t,a} = 1
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{source\_out} \\
  & \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A} : \mathit{head}_a = \mathit{sink}_t} x_{t,a} = 1
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{sink\_in} \\
  & \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A} : \mathit{tail}_a = n} x_{t,a}
    - \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A} : \mathit{head}_a = n} x_{t,a} = 0
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall n \in \mathcal{N},
    \; n \neq \mathit{source}_t,\; n \neq \mathit{sink}_t \tag{flow\_cons} \\
  & y_{t,n} = \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A} : \mathit{tail}_a = n} x_{t,a}
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall n \in \mathcal{N} \tag{node\_visit} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{t,a} \le \mathit{cap}_a
    \qquad \forall a \in \mathcal{A} \tag{arc\_cap} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} z_{p,t} + \mathit{unserved}_{p} = 1
    \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{pass\_assign} \\
  & y_{t,\mathit{orig}_p} \ge z_{p,t}
    \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{origin\_vis} \\
  & y_{t,\mathit{dest}_p} \ge z_{p,t}
    \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{dest\_vis} \\
  & \mathit{travt}_t = \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A}} \mathit{trav}_a \cdot x_{t,a}
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{trav\_time\_def} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{p} \ge \mathit{travt}_t - \mathit{origtime}_p
    - \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - z_{p,t})
    \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & \mathit{unserved}_{p} \le \mathit{demand}_p
    \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{unserved\_limit} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Large‑scale railway rescheduling with reordering, retiming and rerouting
%@ desc :: Integer linear model on a space‑time network. Trains may change order, departure times and choose alternative routes. Objective minimizes total passenger delay and the number of unserved passengers.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Alternative paths (each associated to a train).
%@ index N ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Network nodes (stations).
%@ index G ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Passenger groups (origin‑destinations).
%@ param train_of_path shape=P kind=scalar domain=- :: Train to which a path belongs.
%@ param is_path_of_train shape=T,P kind=matrix domain=- :: Indicator 1 if path p belongs to train t.
%@ param arc_in_path shape=P,N,N kind=matrix domain=- :: Indicator 1 if arc (i,j) is used by path p.
%@ param travel shape=N,N kind=scalar domain=time :: Travel time of arc (i,j).
%@ param cap shape=N,N kind=scalar domain=integer :: Capacity (max number of trains) on arc (i,j).
%@ param demand shape=G kind=scalar domain=passengers :: Number of passengers in group g.
%@ param orig_travel shape=G kind=scalar domain=time :: Planned travel time for group g.
%@ param is_origin shape=G,N kind=matrix domain=- :: Indicator 1 if node i is origin of group g.
%@ param is_dest shape=G,N kind=matrix domain=- :: Indicator 1 if node i is destination of group g.
%@ param serve shape=G,P kind=matrix domain=- :: Indicator 1 if path p serves group g (contains its O‑D pair).
%@ param M_big shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Large constant for big‑M.
%@ param M_penalty shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Penalty weight for unserved passengers.
%@ var z shape=P domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Path selection binary.
%@ var y shape=T,N,N domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Arc usage binary.
%@ var u shape=T,N domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Arrival time of train t at node i.
%@ var w shape=G,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger group g served by train t.
%@ var delta shape=G domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Delay of passenger group g.
%@ var unserved shape=G domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger group g not served.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize weighted passenger delay and unserved penalty.
%@ con path_select kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train chooses exactly one path.
%@ con arc_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Link arc usage to chosen path.
%@ con timing_consistency kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Temporal feasibility of traversed arcs.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arc capacity.
%@ con passenger_assignment kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each passenger group either served or unserved.
%@ con service_feasibility kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Service only if chosen path serves the O‑D pair.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of passenger delay.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{demand}_{g} \cdot \delta_{g} \;+\; \mathit{M\_penalty} \cdot \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{unserved}_{g} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{is\_path\_of\_train}_{t,p} \cdot z_{p} = 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{path\_select} \\
  & y_{t,i,j} - \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{is\_path\_of\_train}_{t,p} \cdot \mathit{arc\_in\_path}_{p,i,j} \cdot z_{p} = 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; i \in \mathcal{N},\; j \in \mathcal{N} \tag{arc\_link} \\
  & u_{t,i} + \mathit{travel}_{i,j} - \mathit{M\_big} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot y_{t,i,j} \le u_{t,j} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; i \in \mathcal{N},\; j \in \mathcal{N} \tag{timing\_consistency} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{t,i,j} \le \mathit{cap}_{i,j} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{N},\; j \in \mathcal{N} \tag{capacity} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} w_{g,t} + \mathit{unserved}_{g} = 1 \qquad \forall g \in \mathcal{G} \tag{passenger\_assignment} \\
  & w_{g,t} - \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{serve}_{g,p} \cdot \mathit{is\_path\_of\_train}_{t,p} \cdot z_{p} \le 0 \qquad \forall g \in \mathcal{G},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{service\_feasibility} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}} \mathit{is\_dest}_{g,i} \cdot u_{t,i}
    - \sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}} \mathit{is\_origin}_{g,i} \cdot u_{t,i}
    - \mathit{orig\_travel}_{g}
    - \mathit{M\_big}
    + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot w_{g,t}
    \le \delta_{g}
    \qquad \forall g \in \mathcal{G},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_def}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway train rescheduling with routing, delay and cancellation
%@ desc :: MILP model for rescheduling trains after a disruption. Decisions: select a route (or cancel) for each train, compute travel time, passenger delay, and respect arc capacities. Objective minimizes total passenger delay and penalty for cancelled trains.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of candidate routes (paths) per train.
%@ index A ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of arcs (track segments) in the space‑time network.
%@ param travelTime shape=T,P kind=matrix domain=time :: Travel time of train t on route p.
%@ param passenger shape=T kind=scalar domain=passengers :: Number of passengers on train t.
%@ param origArrival shape=T kind=scalar domain=time :: Scheduled arrival time of train t (baseline).
%@ param maxDelay shape=T kind=scalar domain=time :: Maximum acceptable delay for train t before cancellation.
%@ param bigPenalty shape=- kind=scalar domain=penalty :: Penalty weight for cancelling a train.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M constraints.
%@ param cap shape=A kind=vector domain=capacity :: Capacity of arc a (max number of trains simultaneously).
%@ param use shape=T,P,A kind=matrix domain=bool :: Indicator if route p of train t uses arc a (1) or not (0).
%@ var r shape=T,P domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Route selection binary variable.
%@ var unsat shape=T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Cancellation indicator binary variable.
%@ var delay shape=T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger delay for train t.
%@ var travel shape=T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Travel time incurred by train t.
%@ obj sense=min name=obj combination=sum :: Minimize weighted passenger delay plus cancellation penalty.
%@ con select_or_cancel kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Choose exactly one route or cancel.
%@ con travel_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Define travel time as selected route's travel time.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Delay is excess over scheduled arrival.
%@ con max_delay kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Enforce max delay or allow cancellation.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arc capacity constraints.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{passenger}_{t} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{t} + \mathit{bigPenalty} \cdot \mathit{unsat}_{t} \tag{obj} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} r_{t,p} + \mathit{unsat}_{t} = 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{select\_or\_cancel} \\
  & \mathit{travel}_{t} = \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{travelTime}_{t,p} \cdot r_{t,p} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{travel\_def} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{t} \ge \mathit{travel}_{t} - \mathit{origArrival}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & \mathit{travel}_{t} \le \mathit{origArrival}_{t} + \mathit{maxDelay}_{t} + \mathit{M} \cdot \mathit{unsat}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{max\_delay} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{use}_{t,p,a} \cdot r_{t,p} \le \mathit{cap}_{a} \qquad \forall a \in \mathcal{A} \tag{capacity} \\
\end{align}
